The raw-content dictionary and level-3 Zstandard 1.5.7 writer produce the original profitable-only data-column bytes; readers preserve actual first-frame and truncated-frame behavior without weakening the committed-tail scanner.
Tagged deltas and strictly shorter ascending runs preserve safe integers, canonical varints, closed tags and expansion bounds before allocation; there is no invented scalar-provenance length limit.

Private hash-pinned Windows x64/MSVCRT Zstandard uses absolute verified loading, exact source/build/license provenance and the unmodified schema dictionary. Per-call compressor/decompressor contexts are freed on success and failure.

Packed decompression enforces its output byte bound before parsing; text byte counts use Node-compatible UTF-16 replacement and UTF-8 encoding. Fatal UTF-8 decoding removes the leading BOM like the original TextDecoder.
Actual STRICT SQLite ANY columns round-trip packed BLOB records and detached reads. Physical corruption is removable only when no later valid turn/end proves commitment.
